bright-dubhe.scope: Alpha Ursae Majoris A; component-resolved primary constraints
bright-dubhe.radiusMethod: Stefan-Boltzmann radius from the paper's adopted primary luminosity and 4660 K, with solar temperature 5772 K
bright-dubhe.note: Dubhe A physical constraints from Guenther et al. (2000): pulsation-model mass 4.25 +/- 0.25 solar masses; adopted primary log L/Lsun=2.5 +/- 0.05, temperature 4660 K, [Fe/H]=-0.19. Radius follows Stefan-Boltzmann scaling. No single age adopted from the mass-dependent model grid. Secondary values are not copied from the primary.

hip-28734.scope: Individual 1 Gem A; WDS 06041+2316, HIP 28734 / HD 41116 system.
hip-28734.massMethod: Dynamical mass from joint astrometric and spectroscopic orbital solution
hip-28734.note: 1 Gem A dynamical mass 1.94 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Lane et al. (2014), Table 7: combined PHASES astrometry and three-component spectroscopy, not a spectral-type estimate or system-total mass.

msc-06041+2316-ba.scope: Individual 1 Gem Ba; WDS 06041+2316, HIP 28734 / HD 41116 system.
msc-06041+2316-ba.massMethod: Dynamical mass from joint astrometric and spectroscopic orbital solution
msc-06041+2316-ba.note: 1 Gem Ba dynamical mass 1.707 +/- 0.005 solar masses from Lane et al. (2014), Table 7: combined PHASES astrometry and three-component spectroscopy, not a spectral-type estimate or system-total mass. Component spectrum F6IV, as reported in the introduction from Strassmeier & Fekel (1990), replaces the older MSC A8V? classification. No dwarf-sequence temperature is assigned to this subgiant. No individual atmosphere, radius, bolometric luminosity, metallicity or age is adopted.

spectralTypeEvidence.source: Lane et al. 2014, introduction, citing Strassmeier & Fekel 1990

msc-06041+2316-bb.scope: Individual 1 Gem Bb; WDS 06041+2316, HIP 28734 / HD 41116 system.
msc-06041+2316-bb.massMethod: Dynamical mass from joint astrometric and spectroscopic orbital solution
msc-06041+2316-bb.note: 1 Gem Bb dynamical mass 1.012 +/- 0.003 solar masses from Lane et al. (2014), Table 7: combined PHASES astrometry and three-component spectroscopy, not a spectral-type estimate or system-total mass. G2V? is the paper's section 3.3 mass-based classification, not a measured spectral subtype. Spectral lines are detected, excluding a white dwarf. No individual atmosphere, radius, bolometric luminosity, metallicity or age is adopted.

spectralTypeEvidence.status: inferred from dynamical mass; not a measured subtype
spectralTypeEvidence.caveat: The detected spectrum excludes a white dwarf; G2V is the paper's mass-based correspondence. The question mark retains its inferred status.
